name: CTA — featured product
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose CTA — featured product.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: ARIA label
settings.how: Enter the aria label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Product
settings.info: Pick in Theme Editor or pass "shopify://products/<handle>" / "<handle>" via JSON.
settings.how: Choose an existing product from Products. Edit its price, inventory, variants, and media in the product record; this control chooses what the section displays.

settings.info: Used only when Product is empty. Example: cotton-tee
